title: A Bayes-Markov Neuromorphic Model of Cortical Orientation Selectivity: A Computational Re-implementation and Quantitative Simulation Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.12388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The emergence of orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) remains a central question in computational neuroscience. Shirazi's Bayes-Markov model proposed a probabilistic explanation for how orientation-selective inhibition can arise from non-oriented lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) inputs through local inference. In that formulation, the activity pattern of striate cortical inhibitory (SCI) cells is estimated from the LGN activity pattern by a maximum a posteriori (MAP) criterion over a two-layer hierarchical Markov random field, and the resulting inference is implemented through a local parallel relaxation algorithm. We provide a computationally explicit re-implementation and quantitative simulation study of this framework. translated_title: 皮层方向选择性的贝叶斯-马尔可夫神经形态模型：计算重实现与定量模拟研究
translated_abstract: 初级视觉皮层（V1）中方向选择性的涌现仍是计算神经科学的核心问题。Shirazi的贝叶斯-马尔可夫模型提出了一种概率解释，说明方向选择性抑制如何通过局部推理从非定向的外侧膝状体（LGN）输入中产生。在该模型中，纹状皮层抑制性（SCI）细胞的活性模式通过最大后验（MAP）准则在两层层次马尔可夫随机场上从LGN活性模式估计得到，并通过局部并行松弛算法实现该推理。我们对该框架进行了计算明确的重新实现和定量模拟研究。我们重建了数学模型，描述了其完全由LGN驱动的更新规则，并实现了一个向量化模拟框架，该框架保留了原始局部团操作，同时使模拟更高效。
tldr: 该论文重新实现了Shirazi的贝叶斯-马尔可夫模型，并定量验证了非定向LGN输入通过局部MAP推理能生成V1方向选择性，提供了可扩展的向量化模拟框架。
en_tdlr: This paper reimplements Shirazi's Bayes-Markov model and quantitatively validates that non-oriented LGN inputs generate V1 orientation selectivity via local MAP inference, offering a scalable vectorized simulation framework.
